metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1959 · North by Northwest
metas.description: A New York City advertising executive goes on the run after being mistaken for a government agent by a group of foreign spies, and falls for a woman whose loyalties he begins to doubt.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1959 · Ben-Hur
metas.description: A Jewish prince is betrayed and sent into slavery by a Roman friend in 1st-century Jerusalem, but it's not long before he regains his freedom and comes back for revenge.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1957 · The Bridge on the River Kwai
metas.description: British POWs are forced to build a railway bridge across the river Kwai for their Japanese captors in occupied Burma, not knowing that the allied forces are planning a daring commando raid through the jungle to destroy it.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1953 · The Wages of Fear
metas.description: In a decrepit South American village, four men are hired to transport an urgent nitroglycerine shipment without the equipment that would make it safe.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1958 · The Hidden Fortress
metas.description: Lured by gold, two greedy peasants unknowingly escort a princess and her general across enemy lines.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1956 · The Ten Commandments
metas.description: Moses, raised as a prince of Egypt in the Pharaoh's household, learns of his true heritage as a Hebrew and his divine mission as the deliverer of his people from slavery.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1956 · The Searchers
metas.description: An American Civil War veteran embarks on a years-long journey to rescue his niece from the Comanches after the rest of his brother's family is massacred in a raid on their Texas farm.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1951 · The African Queen
metas.description: In WWI East Africa, a gin-swilling Canadian riverboat captain is persuaded by a strait-laced English missionary to undertake a trip up a treacherous river and use his boat to attack a German gunship.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1956 · Forbidden Planet
metas.description: A starship crew in the 23rd century goes to investigate the silence of a distant planet's colony, only to find just two survivors, a powerful robot, and the deadly secret of a lost civilization.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1951 · Alice in Wonderland
metas.description: Alice stumbles into the world of Wonderland. Will she get home? Not if the Queen of Hearts has her way.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1955 · Lady and the Tramp
metas.description: The romantic tale of a sheltered uptown Cocker Spaniel dog and a streetwise downtown Mutt.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1959 · Sleeping Beauty
metas.description: After being snubbed by the royal family, a malevolent fairy places a curse on a princess which only a prince can break, along with the help of three good fairies.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1953 · Peter Pan
metas.description: Wendy and her brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1954 · 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
metas.description: A ship sent to investigate a wave of mysterious sinkings encounters the advanced submarine, the Nautilus, commanded by Captain Nemo.
